objectives: Decode taught sm-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sm onset with the vowel and ending.
Distinguish sm from other taught consonant blends.
Reread to repair a missed grapheme and check the complete word.

definitions.definition: A letter or letter group representing a speech sound.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-m-e-l-l and blend the complete word.

Repair the response and explain why.
Complete a fresh item without the model or answer key.
